name: std-algo-astargrid
description: A* shortest path on a walled grid — each tick expands the open cell of least f=g+h, Manhattan heuristic, on cells.

schema.name: std-algo-astargrid
schema.description: A* shortest path on a walled grid — each tick expands the open cell of least f=g+h, Manhattan heuristic, on cells.

emits.description: The grid each expansion — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

events.name: Cells Updated
events.description: The grid each expansion — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: The 8x8 grid; value 0 = open, 1 = wall, 2 = start, 3 = target.

targetRow.label: Target Row
targetRow.description: Row of the goal (denormalized so INIT needn't scan the grid).

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick expands one open cell per step; toggle to start/pause.

startId.label: Start Cell
startId.description: Id (row*cols+col) of the cell A* searches from.

targetId.label: Target Cell
targetId.description: Id (row*cols+col) of the goal; A* stops when it is expanded.

targetCol.label: Target Col
targetCol.description: Col of the goal (denormalized so INIT needn't scan the grid).
